meta.description: Kouland Technology brings hosting, transport, AI assistants, events and on-site tech services together in one connected company.

company.claim: Technology solutions for homes, businesses, and a smarter tomorrow.

innovative.title: Innovative
innovative.body: We build for what's next, with tools that stay useful as you grow.

customer.title: Customer focused

host.summary: Build websites and applications with reliable hosting, domain registration and SSL.
host.description: Everything a business needs to get online and stay online: we design and build the website or application, register the domain, host it and keep it secure.

route.summary: A ground transportation marketplace that connects customers with verified drivers.
route.description: Post a vehicle, boat, equipment or freight job and compare bids from verified independent carriers. Payment is held securely until delivery is confirmed.

bot.summary: AI-powered chat, live support and automation that help your business serve customers.
bot.description: Answer customers at any hour with an assistant trained on your business, and hand over to your team when a person is needed.

event.summary: Event solutions for discovery, promotion, registration, ticketing and community engagement.
event.description: Plan and promote an event, sell tickets, register guests and keep your community engaged before and after the day.

tech.slogan: Professional technology services for homes & businesses.
tech.summary: Reliable on-site and remote tech services that keep your home and business connected and secure.
tech.description: A technician comes to you or connects remotely to install, set up and repair the technology you rely on every day.

hero.subtitle: Hosting, transport, AI assistants, events and on-site tech services, from one team you can reach.

trusted.title: Trusted techs
trusted.body: Vetted technicians who explain what they are doing and why.

booking.title: Convenient booking
booking.body: Pick a time that suits you. We come to you or connect remotely.

guarantee.title: The Kouland guarantee
guarantee.body: If the job is not right, we come back and make it right.

intro.title: Quality tech service at a fair price, since {year}
intro.body1: Kouland Technology started as an on-site and online tech support company: installation, training, setup and repair for homes and businesses. We grew by understanding what our customers expect, then working to do better than that.
intro.body2: Today the same team runs five platforms, so one company can host your website, move your freight, answer your customers, run your event and fix your Wi-Fi.

platforms.title: Five platforms, one connected experience
platforms.subtitle: Each platform solves one job well. Together they cover how a home or a business gets online, moves goods, talks to customers, runs events and keeps its technology working.

popular.title: What customers book most
popular.subtitle: On-site and remote services from KoulandTech, for homes and businesses.

it.title: IT support
it.body: Hand over the day-to-day IT of your business and keep your team focused on customers.

phone.title: Phone & tablet repair
phone.body: Screens, batteries, charging ports and back covers, repaired wherever you are.

security.title: Home security
security.body: Alarms, cameras and video doorbells, installed and set up for you.

tv.title: TV mounting & home theater
tv.body: A technician mounts the TV and connects your audio and video equipment.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi & network
wifi.body: Slow or patchy internet fixed, and new networks set up properly from the start.

remote.title: 24/7 remote support
remote.body: Help from a technician at any hour, without waiting for a visit.

paula.quote: He was very friendly and he explained what he was doing and made sure I understood what he was saying. I am very pleased with him and I feel good about that company.

jasmine.quote: These guys knew what they were doing. They had their own vac and used it. When they walked out the door all we had to do was sit back and watch our new TV.

corey.quote: Quick, with amazing quality on the repair. He fixed my wife's iPhone screen in under 15 minutes. We really like this service.

satisfaction.title: You should never have to chase the people you hired
satisfaction.body: Nothing is more frustrating than a contractor you can never reach. We work so that you feel like our only customer, and we take the stress out of the job from the first call to the last check.

platformsPage.heading: The Kouland family

aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.description: Kouland Technology has provided technology services since {year}. Learn who we are and how we work.
aboutPage.heading: Technology that works, from people you can reach
aboutPage.subtitle: Kouland Technology, Inc. started in {year} with a simple goal: quality tech service at a fair price.
aboutPage.story1: We began as an on-site and online tech support company: installing, setting up, training and repairing technology for homes and businesses. Our customers kept asking for more, so we kept building.
aboutPage.story2: Today Kouland Technology runs several platforms. KoulandHost puts businesses online. KoulandRoute moves vehicles and freight. KoulandBot answers customers. KoulandEvent brings people together. KoulandTech keeps homes and offices connected.
aboutPage.story3: What has not changed is how we work. We listen to what you need, we tell you plainly what it takes, and we stay reachable after the job is done.

page.title: Careers
page.description: Join Kouland Technology. Apply for a role on KoulandHost, KoulandRoute, KoulandBot, KoulandEvent, KoulandTech or our company teams.
page.heading: Build what's next with us
page.subtitle: Technicians, developers, support agents, event organisers and more: every Kouland platform is run by people who care about the customer in front of them.
page.introTitle: One company, many ways to grow
page.introBody: Working at Kouland means seeing the same customer from many sides: the website we host for them, the truck that moves their goods, the assistant that answers their clients and the technician at their door. Tell us where you fit and we will take it from there.
page.whyTitle: What you get when you join

impact.title: Real impact
impact.body: Your work reaches customers directly, and you see the result.

growth.title: Room to grow
growth.body: Five platforms mean new skills and new responsibilities when you are ready.

team.body: Work with people across hosting, logistics, AI, events and field service.

flexible.title: Flexible work
